text:
sara: Heads-up — customer AcmeRetail asked us to onboard Seraph-18B for product search reranking. Requirements: private deployment (VPC), FP4 quant target, p95 latency <= 120ms for 512 tokens, and parity with their current 13B model on dev evals. Can ops/ML triage blockers?
praveen: Added to intake board. Do we have the model artifacts and a short eval set? Also, any license or data residency constraints?
sara: Link to artifacts: https://s3.redwood.internal/acmeretail/seraph-18b/v1/model.tar.gz
Model metadata:
```
arch: decoder-only
params: 18_000_000_000
tokenizer: byte-level BPE (custom)
vocab: 50288
sequence_len: 2048
format: hf-transformers (pt)
license: permissive-commercial
```
Sample eval bundle: https://s3.redwood.internal/acmeretail/seraph-18b/v1/eval.zip (5k labeled queries, anonymized)
claire: Quick Qs: 1) Are dev evals held-out and stable? 2) What's their acceptance threshold (metric + delta)? 3) Any prompt engineering needed?
miguel: Did a tiny perf smoke locally (docker kernel, small batch) w/ a naive q4 compile on a8g:```
miguel: p95=88ms @512 toks, throughput=230 tok/s (single request), mem_peak=18.2GB (no kv cache)
```
miguel: Notes: this was without optimized kernels or KV cache; FP4 path still prototype. We should expect ~15-25% improvement after kernel tuning and batching.
praveen: Good baseline. blocker checklist I'm thinking:
- artifacts validated + checksum
- tokenizer compatibility w/ our tokenization service
- privacy / PII review of eval bundle
- quantization plan (FP4 fallback to FP16)
- target infra: Dedicated (g5/g6 equivalent) vs Private VPC mapping
- canary & rollback plan
claire: For evaluation plan:
- primary metric: nDCG@10 on query rerank set (5k)
- secondary: avg latency (p50,p95), token-match regression tests on 1k prompts
- artifact diff eval: pairwise compare outputs with their 13B baseline, compute win/tie/loss and regression share
- quality gates: nDCG drop <= 1.5% and regression share < 5% (customer agreed)
praveen: Assignments?
sara: I'll own customer coordination + artifact upload verification.
miguel: I'll run quant experiments and perf harness (FP4, FP16 baseline).
claire: I'll run the eval suite, compute metrics, and produce regression report.
praveen: Ops: I'll scope VPC networking, KMS for keys, and capacity mapping. Can everyone post ETA for first smoke by EOD Tue?
sara: ETA EOD Tue for artifact checks and sample run.
miguel: Perf smoke ETA Tue EOD. Will try two quant configs: q4_fast and q4_stable.
claire: Eval smoke ETA Wed morning — need the tokenization mapping preserved.
eval-bot: Preliminary eval run queued (job_id: eval-7892). Will post results when done.
praveen: Canary plan draft:
1) Internal dedicated pool (2x g5 nodes) with traffic mirrored from staging for analysis only (no user-facing).
2) If metrics pass quality gates for 24h, escalate to small private pool behind canary flag (5% traffic).
3) 48h monitored, auto-rollback on reg count > 5% or latency > 120ms p95.
sara: Customer also asked for a lightweight hallucination check (fact-coherence) — Claire can we add that as a tertiary check?
claire: Yes, will add a 500-sample fact-coherence harness and include Δprecision in the report.
miguel: Quick technical note: tokenizer is slightly different — we'll need to add a token mapping shim in the tokenizer service or canonicalize to our BPE during preprocessing. That will be part of the smoke.
sara: I'll update intake ticket with shim details.
praveen: Created internal ticket INF-11234 and linked the artifacts. Also pinging security for audit trail.
sara: Thanks — :thumbsup: Anything else?
claire: One more: request a golden prompt set from customer that represents production traffic (if possible). If not, we'll generate synthetic adversarial prompts for regression hunting.
sara: I'll ask for the golden prompts.
eval-bot: Eval-run complete: nDCG@10 = 0.742 (13B baseline = 0.755), Δ = -1.7% ; regression share = 4.2% ; p95 latency (miguel's perf) = 88ms (unoptimized). Full report linked: https://internal.redwood/reports/INF-11234/seraph-18b-smoke.pdf
praveen: Snapshot reaction: Close to gate but nDCG is slightly outside the 1.5% window. Need to see post-quant run. Miguel, can you try q4_stable and FP16 and post diffs?
miguel: Starting q4_stable -> will post numbers in thread.
sara: Great — keep updates here. We'll reconvene after quant runs and decide canary go/no-go.
praveen: Marking priority: HIGH (customer SLA timeline next month). If anyone hits a blocker, DM me immediately.
sara: Thanks team.
